summary: Figure Technology Solutions filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $600 million offering of 8.500% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries, issued under Rule 144A. Interest is payable semiannually at 8.500%, with maturity on July 31, 2031. Redemption provisions include a make-whole call prior to July 31, 2028, and an equity-clause redemption up to 40% of principal. A change-of-control put is set at 101% of par. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
